name: CaseHardRemScalePadding
description: SEED contract for the CSS/DOM conformance fixture case "hard-rem-scale-padding" (units). The fixture varies CSS CONSTRUCTS, not prop spaces, so the prop space is deliberately EMPTY: every axis the capture would enumerate is held at nothing, and the whole measurement is the computed truth of one mounted rendering. Construct: padding-left: 1.5rem / padding-right: 0.75rem — the ROOT-relative scale
